decks.notes: The deck focuses on fast, aggressive creature play combined with burn spells to control the board and deal damage quickly. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional mana ramp. The deck includes a mix of powerful creatures like Phlage and Ragavan to apply pressure, along with control elements like Static Prison and Goblin Bombardment. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature aggression and direct damage, using the resources efficiently to maintain a strong board presence.

This deck focuses on using powerful Elemental creatures like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation to quickly overwhelm your opponent with aggressive plays. It also includes a strong control element with cards like Force of Negation and Subtlety to disrupt your opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Solitude provides additional removal options to keep the board clear for your creatures to attack. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency and power in every game.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to create a fast-paced aggressive strategy that utilizes powerful creatures like Amped Raptor, Guide of Souls, and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, supported by burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Static Prison and Blood Moon to control the board and hinder the opponent's game plan. Utilizing the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring adds an additional layer of consistency to the deck. The overall goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient threats and disruptive cards.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and utilizing a variety of creatures, spells, and enchantments to quickly overpower the opponent. It includes powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Guide of Souls, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Goblin Bombardment. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Static Prison to control the game. With a versatile toolbox of cards and a focus on early aggression, this deck aims to apply pressure to the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with a combination of counter spells, removal, and hand disruption. The win condition is to control the board using cards like Murktide Regent and Orcish Bowmasters, while also generating card advantage with cards like Psychic Frog. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by answering threats efficiently and maintaining a strong hand advantage. It utilizes a combination of powerful spells like Counterspell, Fatal Push, and Thoughtseize to control the game and secure a victory through attrition.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disruption and removal spells to control the game, while also utilizing card draw and counterspells to maintain advantage. The deck includes powerful creatures such as Murktide Regent and Orcish Bowmasters to provide win conditions and pressure the opponent. By consistently disrupting the opponent's game plan and controlling the board, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents in a slow and methodical manner. The combination of removal, counter magic, and threats allows the deck to adapt to different matchups and strategies efficiently.

The deck focuses on using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate to cheat out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Ulamog, the Defiler from the graveyard for a quick win. Thoughtseize and Force of Negation help protect the combo pieces while Leyline Binding and Tainted Indulgence provide control elements. The strategy revolves around quickly filling up the graveyard with key creatures and then reanimating them at instant speed for a surprise attack, catching opponents off guard and overwhelming them for a swift victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards such as Underworld Breach, Vizier of Tumbling Sands, and Wish to repeatedly cast combo pieces and generate infinite mana with Lotus Field and Hidden Strings. This allows the player to continuously loop through their deck and win the game through various win conditions such as Tolaria West tutoring for key pieces or using The One Ring for a powerful one-shot finish. The deck aims to assemble its combo quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck aims to control the game by using powerful control spells like Teferi, Time Raveler and Supreme Verdict to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key card, The One Ring, provides a powerful win condition and can generate significant card advantage. By efficiently using removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Solitude, as well as counter spells like Force of Negation, the deck can maintain control of the board while setting up for a decisive victory with The One Ring. The deck also includes draw engines like Consign to Memory and Nulldrifter to maintain card advantage.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board with cards like All Is Dust and Kozilek's Return, while also ramping up to play powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. The deck utilizes mana acceleration with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talismans, along with Eldrazi Temple and Ugin's Labyrinth. The goal is to cast big Eldrazi threats early and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures. The deck also includes some land destruction and card draw to maintain control over the game.

This deck focuses on using ramp and control elements to quickly bring out powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul and Ulamog. By using cards like Through the Breach and Eldrazi Temple, the deck aims to accelerate its mana production and cheat out large threats ahead of schedule. Control elements like All is Dust and Kozilek's Return help to deal with opponent's threats while cards like Ancient Stirrings and Grove of the Burnwillows provide card advantage and fixing. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive Eldrazi creatures while maintaining control of the game.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays, utilizing powerful cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Amped Raptor to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also includes cards like Guide of Souls and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer for additional aggression and card advantage. The deck also incorporates disruption elements like Lightning Bolt and Blood Moon to control the board and hinder the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to apply consistent pressure and close out the game swiftly before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on using various cards to quickly reanimate powerful creatures like Ulamog, the Defiler and Emperor of Bones. This is achieved through cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Leyline Binding. The deck also includes control elements such as Force of Negation and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Ephemerate and Psychic Frog allows for additional resource manipulation and card advantage. By utilizing this instant reanimation strategy, the deck aims to overwhelm and outpace the opponent in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, hand disruption, and targeted removal spells. The deck aims to control the game by countering key spells, removing threats from the board, and grinding out card advantage with card draw and card filtering. The deck also includes some creatures with disruptive abilities to further control the opponent's board. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using counterspells and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It also aims to generate card advantage through cards like Snapcaster Mage and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The win condition of the deck is to close out the game with efficient threats like Murktide Regent and Thundertrap Trainer. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure the deck can cast its spells on time and support its dual-color requirements. Overall, the deck seeks to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent in a battle of attrition.

This deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a mix of aggressive creatures and burn spells, maximizing damage output and efficiency. The companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, provides additional support and consistency to the deck. The main focus is on utilizing powerful creatures like Scion of Draco and Tribal Flames alongside versatile removal like Lightning Bolt and Leyline Binding. The deck's mana base allows for strong consistency in casting spells and maintaining pressure on opponents, keeping the pace fast and aggressive throughout the game.
